description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating objects, specifically 'omit' and 'pick' functions that create new objects excluding or including specified keys.

methods.name: export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( omit
methods.description: Creates a new object by omitting specified keys from the input object.

methods.name: export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>( pick
methods.description: Creates a new object by selecting specified keys from the input object.

ctags.name: omit
ctags.pattern: /^export function omit<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/

ctags.name: pick
ctags.pattern: /^export function pick<T extends object, U extends (keyof T)[]>($/
